thread:
kevin: quick check on Encryption settings panel- small accessibility nits and copy for retention/region. noticed a weird jump when user picks a region + long org name.
tara: can you describe the jump? mobile only?
kevin: modal height changes and the KMS badge moves under the key label on 360px widths. also the retention helper text falls behind the sticky footer buttons.
lee: sketch idea: pin the retention helper below the control and keep KMS badge inline with the key label. avoid absolute positioning for badges.
tara: agree. for long org names we should truncate visually and provide aria-label + title with full name. also add a verb in the retention microcopy: right now it says "30 days" which is ambiguous.
kevin: proposed audit log copy: currently "Rotation: previous versions retained 30 days". suggest "Previous key versions remain usable for decryption for 30 days, then permanently deleted."
ux-bot: Accessibility scan: "contrast fail: .helper-text (2.6:1), missing focusable for KMS badge, modal close button not first in tab order."
tara: action items:
- make KMS badge inline and focusable (lee)
- add aria-label + title for long tenant names (lee)
- update retention microcopy to explicit decryption window (kevin)
- raise helper text contrast to 4.5:1 and add focus outline (design)
- ensure close button is first interactive element in modal (eng)
kevin: timeline: want this in next console patch. lee can you mock quick changes?
lee: will mock and post in #design by EOD, i'll add mobile screenshots.
tara: i'll run a short SR pass after mocks. :white_check_mark:
notes: Short thread about Encryption settings modal: region selection causing layout shifts, KMS badge placement, truncation/aria-label for long tenant names, clarify audit log retention copy, contrast and focusable badge from ux-bot, and small action list with owners and timeline.
